review.title: Drain review: `river-assay-1`, the assay verifies a River reel, the axes drift that kept diagonal reels from verifying is fixed, the River's county post is on (Opus 5.5 implementer at max effort; F-RES1-1, F-RES1-6, F-RVA1-1)

bookkeeping.rowText: The assay replays an `e10-river` reel in the ceremony world (the lever's stamped no-wave Claim, `scripts/assay-replay.mjs` and the watch path in `src/main.ts`), reads the ceremony's completed score as the verdict's outcome (`timeAlive` at a 1e-6 tolerance against the microsecond print), and the headless arm refuses `e10-river` by name (the worker's `isAgentTape` already sends River reels to the browser arm). Fresh diagonal-walk River reels VERIFY through the county's own worker and rank first on the Claim Ledger (`eef28ae4` desktop, `10904fbe` phone; the spec's `ef71da37`/`027f7f02` through the real door handlers); tampers rejected (gold, timeAlive, pan tick). The harvest seams follow the run's seed with live seeds keeping the constant layout (form (b), attended ruling: no live layout moves; the literal form moved every unpinned Claim's seams and reddened onboarding). F-RVA1-1 fixed in its general form: a live solo run moves by the rounded axes its reel records (`recordedIntents`); before, ANY browser reel with a diagonal tick (joysticks included) could never verify, since the reel's birth on 2026-07-31. `RIVER_STANDING_POSTS_ENABLED = true` in its own final commit: one standing POST at the pan carrying the reel, stored pending, verified by the worker; still one after a second pan, a reload, a re-pull. Unchanged: heat-15 probe, r1 and r2 VERIFIED byte-identical; the era-6 agent tape and the heat-15 probe identical through the headless arm; seven replays byte-identical base against final; null floors 83 of 83. The four pre-fix River reels stay rejected (their raw axes were never recorded). Spec 6/6 both projects; adjacents 54/54; `river-assay.test.mjs` 3/3 (spliced after the runner); the worker's tests 21/21; test:stats rc 0; node-guards 1028 of 1040 with every red attributed on a base control. Engine hash PINNED {PIN}. F-RVA1-6 (new, pre-existing, every contract): a pause press is recorded as `set_pause paused:true` and the resume never, so a replay stops at the pause and ANY paused human standing is unassayable today (the seed-run human standing of 2026-08-20 stops at tick 274 on base and tip); a paused River run would rank while pending then drop, like every other contract; the corrective `tape-pause-fix-1` is authored for Astra and queues behind this landing. F-RVA1-2/-3 noted; F-RES1-7 still open. Deployed (the droplet's assay worker restarts with the new instrument). `reviews/river-assay-1.md`.
